title: Streetwear, loud youth brand
when: High contrast, dark palette, community imagery.

steps.when: a soft brand tint (kids, beauty, playful and premium looks)
steps.note: The accent colour lives only here.

variants.when: one commercial promise on a dark bar: the usual choice
2-3 short service promises the merchant confirmed

steps.when: a flat menu of up to 6-8 short items: the categories show on desktop
steps.note: Then apply `dark-chrome` too: the header on the dark palette.

variants.when: a nested or long menu that would not fit as links
a short flat menu and a left-aligned look (journal, dense catalog)

steps.when: photography with a quiet zone for the live text
steps.note: 2:1 wordmark with a short live manifesto.

variants.when: one strong text-free image, full height on phones (journal, premium, dark drop)
the merchant has a short silent loop with its own phone cut
a designed first screen: headline, button and photo composed in the markup (kit-custom-sections)

steps.when: two big collections instead of a category row
steps.note: Two category tiles, linked. Its title is a phrase about what the store sells: the storefront makes it the page's H1 (a banner title never is).

variants.when: two departments or audiences (women and men, adults and kids)
4-8 categories with their own photos

steps.when: bigger cards for the second source, a change of rhythm

variants.when: new arrivals or bestsellers, 12 cards
every packshot on one backdrop: an edge-to-edge product wall (gallery look)

steps.when: the default story: eyebrow, a heading phrase, 16 px text at 560-640 px, a button to a real page, a 1:1 or 3:4 photo (`mediaRatio`; kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: One story block in the middle third that leads somewhere: a button or a last-line link to the catalog, a collection or the About page.

variants.when: no photo for the story: one centred statement of 100-200 characters ending with a link
native fallback the merchant edits in the cabinet: a narrowed section, `###` heading, one paragraph of 300 characters or less ending with a link

steps.note: Another source; vary the column count.

variants.when: one curated row of 4

steps.when: customer photos, stores or press the merchant has

variants.when: one strong real review with a name and a photo (kit-custom-sections)
3-6 real reviews (kit-custom-sections)

steps.when: dark drop and playful: a running line of short brand words (kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: The signature block: one block that only this store has, chosen by the look (references/looks.md).

variants.when: the merchant has short vertical videos (kit-custom-sections)
journal and premium: one brand phrase set large across the page (kit-custom-sections)
native fallback: a full-bleed photo pair of the drop with a corner caption
a rounded theme (playful, soft): the questions on one card
service answers as untitled rows under the last grid (left-aligned themes)
off-white, grey or cream: soft and premium looks

deviations.subscribe-missing: The group closes on a dark FAQ; add `EmailSubscription` if the brand runs a newsletter.
